versions.content: Support of Transmit Certificate Description: Diagnostics in AUTOSAR shall support the ISO 14229-1:2020 service 0x29 "Authentication" with the sub-function "TransmitCertificate" allows a client to write certificates for different use cases into the server. Some of the use cases can be directly internally handled inside the AUTOSAR modules while others require an implementation in scope of an application. Rationale: Possibility to upload a certificate into the server. Use Case: Security related applications rely on the use of certificates. Among the use cases are: • secure variant coding • secure time update AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – ▽ 37 of 75 Document ID 4: AUTOSAR_FO_RS_Diagnostics Requirements on Diagnostics AUTOSAR FO R25-11 △ Supporting Material: –
